name: seo-console
description: Turn Claude Code into a senior product-marketing manager over Google Search Console: search analytics, striking-distance keywords, CTR gaps, cannibalization, on-page and whole-site audits, indexing coverage, and PageSpeed.

credentials.title: Service account key path
credentials.description: Absolute path to your Google service-account key JSON. Required for the Search Console tools; seo_audit and pagespeed work without it. Leave blank to fall back to a GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS already in your environment.

pagespeed_key.title: PageSpeed API key (optional)
pagespeed_key.description: A PageSpeed Insights API key for higher quota. Optional; pagespeed works without one on a lower quota.
